tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Searches publicly visible timeshare rental stays on vakaymood.com by place, resort, date window, sleeping capacity, nightly price and brand. tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Returns the full detail of one publicly visible stay: unit type, bed configuration, fixed check-in and check-out dates, itemized pricing in USD, standard cancellation terms, the optional VakayFlex cancellation upgrade with its fee and guaranteed refund, notices such as a parking charge or renovation

tools.name: get_resort
tools.description: Returns one resort: address, coordinates, amenities, unit types, policies, its page on vakaymood.com and its published questions and answers, which cover topics such as parking and its cost.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: Returns every published VakayMood collection: a curated group of resorts (a destination, a brand, a price cap or a season) with its current starting nightly price in USD and its page on vakaymood.com. The slug of each collection identifies it in get_collection.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Returns one published collection: its editorial as sanitized HTML, published questions and answers, member resorts with their vakaymood.com pages and starting nightly prices, and its lowest priced available stays in ascending price order.
